correctness.rationale: Explicit six-form Cartier basis with swap blocks V,W and 2x2 block B; Frobenius-twisted stable rank gives L,D,K. On the smooth discriminant-complement V and W are nonzero. Two package scripts executed successfully; full GF11 121-parameter check independently reconstructs Cartier ranks. No inference from finite samples is made.
